note: Inyo NF campground at about 9,500 ft on Tioga Pass Road (SR-120), just east of Yosemite's Tioga Pass entrance, along Lee Vining Creek where it enters Ellery Lake; a rocky rise separates the campground from the lake. Open only while Tioga Road is open. Bear lockers at every site. --Claude
summary: Ellery Lake (Inyo NF): FS page + Inyo camping page + rec.gov search (none) + topo, imagery and 3DEP. First-come only (stored reservable true was wrong); $28 + $10 extra vehicle; 12 sites, up to 28 ft; vault + potable. Lakefront -> lakeview lead (a 5-16 m rocky rib between the loop and the lake). Closed for the season. Season dates not found.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (downgrade, lakefront -> lakeview; alternative creekside): the stored evidence ('RV pads on open decomposed-granite apron running unobstructed to the SW Ellery Lake shore within ~30-50m') doesn't fit the terrain. 3DEP puts a rocky rib between the campground road (2897-2899 m) and the lake (2894.3 m): 2903.6 m at 37.9369, 2905 m at 37.9365, 2914 m at 37.9372. The shore is 100-110 m from the road. Only the few SE-end sites on the open granite rise (~37.9368,-119.2429; ~37.9366,-119.2427) are close: 35-50 m from the shore, but on top of the rise, with a ~10 m drop over ~30 m (about 18 degrees) to the water. That is a climb-down (kayak test fails), so lakeview at best for those sites; topo and imagery show open granite with sparse trees, so the view likely holds. The pads west of the road sit 15-30 m from Lee Vining Creek through trees, so creekside is the alternative if the reviewer prefers the creek, but no named pad confirms it. Not below a dam: the camp is above Ellery Lake's level at its inlet. FS gives no site numbers or map.
